observations.content: Upstream Dittobyte/Zonith releases (v0.5.1, v0.5.0) are "immutable": false; its workflows are content-guard.yml and release.yml (same name as RELEASE_WORKFLOW, so attest.rs verify_release can be reused). Assets: TotK-Setup-<ver>-windows.zip and TotK-Setup-x86_64.AppImage with sha256 digests.

Edited launcher/src-tauri/src/zonith.rs: added macro_rules! zonith_repo ("Dittobyte/Zonith"), pub const REPO, RELEASES_URL now concat! from zonith_repo!; added immutable field (serde default) to GhRelease and Latest (serde skip); added pub fn verify_origin(l, attested) that refuses non-immutable releases then calls attested(sha256), with player messages ending "Nothing was changed."; added test only_an_immutable_attested_release_is_installed.

Edited zonith_cmds.rs run_job: now starts with download::agent(true) and zonith::verify_origin(l, |sum| crate::attest::verify_release(&agent, zonith::REPO, &l.tag, &l.asset, sum))? before creating the tag dir; same agent reused for download::fetch.
Decision: no bypass for debug PKP_ZONITH_RELEASES_URL testhook (attestation still checked against real REPO, so stand-in releases can't install); documented in README instead.

Edited tools/fork/check-guards.sh: added zon/zcmd file vars and guards that zonith.rs has verify_origin and 'if !l.immutable', zonith_cmds.rs calls verify_origin with attest::verify_release and zonith::REPO, and RELEASES_URL is built from zonith_repo!. Added test-sync.sh case "a clean merge that drops the Zonith attestation check is refused" (expects exit 3).

Updated launcher/README.md Zonith section to describe immutable+attestation requirement and debug-hook limitation. Was about to update FORK.md "A launcher that checks" section (line 16) to mention Zonith; tests not yet run.
